invalid: Invalid target size: downsampling within the pixel budget only.
limits: No interpolation or dithering. Small details may be lost. Alpha is selected, not blended; hard edges set alpha ≥128 to 255, otherwise 0. Protection masks block geometry changes.
uncertain: Uncertain Laceframe heuristic; compare neighboring grids. Sprite Fusion exports no confidence.
noGrid: No evidenced grid candidate. Choose the target resolution manually.
uniform: Uniform target grid · review details manually
sync: Synchronized zoom and pan · Alt/Space drag · wheel requires image focus
